packages.farcooler-cli: The CLI the Mac app invokes: launchd links, app updates, shell/PTY and subprocess behavior.
packages.farcooler-client: Native SSH, pipe/SIGPIPE, FFI and Keychain paths used by the Mac client.
packages.farcooler-daemon: Native runner, including launchd startup from the farcoolerd entry point.
packages.farcooler-daemon-contracts: Mac standalone LaunchAgent startup exposed from the crate root.
packages.farcooler-tmux: Real tmux and Darwin PTY/socket behavior.
packages.farcooler-transport: Unix socket peer credentials, pipe and subprocess behavior.
packages.farcooler-ceremony: Native reachability and socket error mappings.

farcooler-store.engine_cutover: Darwin proc_listpidspath, flock ownership and recovery.

farcooler-core.shell: Darwin directory-service-backed passwd lookup used for the login shell.
farcooler-core.programs: Login shell discovery and process-group termination under launchd PATH.
farcooler-core.local_time: Darwin libc time_t/tm and localtime_r ABI.
farcooler-core.scratch: Native temporary-directory creation, permissions and cleanup.
